description: This file defines repository classes for database operations related to users, matches, events, emojis, and highlights within a sports live stream platform backend.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A base class providing common database operations, extended by specific repositories.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository for user-related database operations, including create, read, and update functions.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository for match-related database operations such as fetching matches with filters and getting live/upcoming matches.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository for event-related database operations including retrieval and filtering of events.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Repository for emoji-related database operations, including reactions and emoji asset retrieval.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository for highlight operations, providing access to highlights and related data.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates user information based on provided data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a list of matches with optional filtering by status and sport.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a match by its ID, including related entities.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Fetches all matches currently marked as live.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming matches within a specified number of days.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a list of events with optional filters for sport type and featured status.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an event by its ID, including associated matches.

methods.name: List[EmojiAssetDB] get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of active emojis.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji asset by its ID.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Adds an emoji reaction from a user to an event.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Provides a summary of reactions (counts, top emojis) for a given event.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches highlights, optionally filtered by match ID.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a highlight by its ID.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent and popular featured highlights.
